verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms an llms.txt at documentation.datalab.to that returns HTTP 200 and is a structured index linking to Markdown versions of the docs pages. Many doc and API-reference pages are served as raw .md (webhooks, form filling, pipelines, file management, the API reference), so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-readable docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other agent-specific guides, no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the probed paths (all 404), and no independent corroboration of agent use.
